instruction: Install the Immersive Reader extension in Chrome.
gt_steps: Open the Chrome Web Store listing `Immersive Reader`.

result.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$knownId='cccnhdbjafjobcppogeaaabofifbpdho'; $googleRoot=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Google'; $found=$false; Get-ChildItem $googleRoot -Directory -Filter 'Chrome*' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { $userData=Join-Path $_.FullName 'User Data'; Get-ChildItem $userData -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { $extensions=Join-Path $_.FullName 'Extensions'; Get-ChildItem $extensions -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } } | ForEach-Object { $extension=$_; if ($extension.Name -eq $knownId) { $found=$true }; Get-ChildItem $extension.FullName -Filter manifest.json -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { try { $manifest=Get-Content $_.FullName -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $manifestDir=$_.DirectoryName; $names=@($manifest.name,$manifest.short_name) | Where-Object { $_ }; foreach ($name in $names) { if ($name -match '(?i)immersive[ _-]*reader') { $found=$true }; if ($name -match '^__MSG_(.+)__$') { $key=$Matches[1]; Get-ChildItem (Join-Path $manifestDir '_locales') -Filter messages.json -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { try { $messages=Get-Content $_.FullName -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $entry=$messages.PSObject.Properties[$key]; if ($entry -and $entry.Value.message -match '(?i)immersive[ _-]*reader') { $found=$true } } catch {} } } } } catch {} } }; if ($found) { Write-Output 'IMMERSIVE_READER_EXTENSION_FOUND'; exit 0 }; Write-Output 'IMMERSIVE_READER_EXTENSION_NOT_FOUND'; exit 1"
